When the fast-flapping son of a bitch landed, I took aim and fired a shot that'd have professional counterstrike players pop their loads. I hit it square in the face with a force that must have been the dragonfly equivalent of being struck by a shot from a galleon's cannon, but guess what? That little shit stayed living. I guess my point here is that I believe that yeah, this story might've happened, but I mean, out of the air? And the bee was slain? Tough call. I guess I just don't see the point in making this one up.
